appendix_title: THE ŚĀKTA TANTRAS OF BHAIRAVA DIVISIONS (64 in number, in 8 groups)
content:
This appendix lists 64 Śākta Tantras, divided into 8 groups of 8.

I. BHAIRAVA DIVISION
1. Svacchanda-bhairava-tantra
2. Caṇḍa-bhairava
3. Krodha-bhairava
4. Unmatta-bhairava
5. Asita-bhairava
6. Ruru-bhairava
7. Jhaṅkara-bhairava
8. Kapālīśa-bhairava

II. YĀMALA DIVISION
9. Brahma-yāmala
10. Rudra-yāmala
11. Viṣṇu-yāmala
12. Skanda-yāmala
13. Gautamiya-yāmala
14. Atharva-yāmala
15. Vetāla-yāmala
16. Ruru-yāmala

III. МАТА-TANTRA DIVISION
17. Raktā-mata-tantra
18. Peṭikā-mata
19. Bhāruṇḍī-mata
20. Iḍā-mata
21. Piṅgalā-mata
22. Nīlakeśī-mata
23. Śāmbara-mata
24. Utphullā-mata

IV. MAṄGALĀ DIVISION
25. Bhairava-maṅgalā-tantra
26. Candra-garbha-maṅ-galā
27. Śānti-maṅgalā
28. Sumaṅgalā
29. Sarva-maṅgalā
30. Vijaya-maṅgalā
31. Ugra-maṅgalā
32. Sad-bhāva-maṅgalā

V. CAKRA DIVISION
33. Svara-cakra-tantra (Mantra-)
34. Varṇa-cakra
35. Nāḍī-cakra (Śakti)
36. Guhya-cakra (Kalā)
37. Kāla-cakra (Bindu)
38. Saura-cakra (Nāda)
39. Āgneya-cakra
40. Somaja-cakra

VI. ŚIKHĀ DIVISION
41. Saukri
42. Mandā-(Viṇa-śkhā)
43. Mahocchuṣmā
44. Bhairavī (Svarascheda-)
45. Śāmbarī (Ḍāmara)
46. Prapañcakī
47. Mātṛ-bhedī
48. Rudra-kālī

VII. BAHURŪPĀ DIVISION
49. Andhakī
50. Ruru-bhedā
51. Śaṁkhā
52. Śūlinī
53. Karṇa-moṭī
54. Ṭaṅkī
55. Jvālinī
56. Mātṛ-rodhinī

VIII. VĀGĪŚA-DIVISION
57. Siddhā
58. Citrā
59. Hṛllekhā
60. Bhairavī
61. Kadambikā
62. Haṁsinī-(Candralekhā)
63. Haṁsa-mālā
64. Candra-koṭi
summary: This appendix, taken from 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia', provides a classified list of 64 Śākta Tantras associated with the Bhairava traditions. The Tantras are organized into eight distinct divisions, with each division containing eight texts. The divisions are Bhairava, Yāmala, Māta-Tantra, Maṅgalā, Cakra, Śikhā, Bahurūpā, and Vāgīśa.
purpose: The purpose of this appendix is to present a systematic classification of the 64 Śākta Tantras of the Bhairava divisions. It serves as a reference guide or a taxonomy for scholars and practitioners studying these specific tantric texts.
key_information: The appendix lists 64 specific texts known as Śākta Tantras.
These Tantras are categorized into 8 groups, referred to as 'divisions'.
Each of the 8 divisions contains exactly 8 Tantras.
The eight divisions are: I. BHAIRAVA, II. YĀMALA, III. МАТА-TANTRA, IV. MAṄGALĀ, V. CAKRA, VI. ŚIKHĀ, VII. BAHURŪPĀ, and VIII. VĀGĪŚA.
Some entries in the list include additional parenthetical notes, such as '(Bindu)' for Kāla-cakra or '(Śakti)' for Nāḍī-cakra.
The appendix is identified as Appendix VI from a larger work titled 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia'.

tables_and_data.description: A comprehensive list of 64 Śākta Tantras organized into 8 divisions.
tables_and_data.data_summary: The appendix contains a single, structured list that enumerates 64 tantric texts by name. The list is broken down into eight thematic sections (divisions), each containing eight numbered entries. The numbering is sequential from 1 to 64 across all divisions. The divisions provide a categorical framework for understanding this corpus of texts.
